title: Adukkhamasukhī
text: 3 Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || 4 Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || || 5 Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Adukkhamasukhī attā
